_about: Batch B7 writer: MoE routing, mega-MoE, expert parallelism, EPLB, userbuffer. Pages: concepts/moe-routing, concepts/mega-moe, concepts/expert-parallelism, concepts/eplb, code/v4-mlp, code/eplb, code/userbuffer.

routed-expert.short: An expert that gets only the tokens that the gate sends to it. Expert parallelism splits the routed experts across the EP ranks.

correction-bias.short: e_score_correction_bias: one fp32 value per expert, added to the expert scores to choose the top-k. In the usual noaux_tc method, it does not change the weights of the chosen experts. The kernel is not in the repository.

logical-expert.short: An expert as the model defines it. The gate chooses logical experts. One logical expert can have more than one physical copy (slot) on the devices.

redundant-expert.short: An extra physical slot that holds a second copy of a busy logical expert. DeepInfer calls them extra experts (DEEPINFER_OVERRIDE_NUM_EXTRA_EXPERTS).

eplb.short: Expert-parallel load balancer. It counts the tokens of each expert, gives busy experts extra copies, and moves expert weights so that the EP ranks get about the same work.

moe-lb.short: The MoE load-balance ratio in the DeepInfer statistics log. It is the tokens of the busiest EP rank divided by the mean tokens per rank. Both are summed over steps and MoE layers. 1.0 is perfect balance.

grouped-gemm.short: One kernel launch that does many matrix multiplications, one for each expert, on rows that are sorted into groups by expert.

mega-moe.short: DeepGEMM kernels that do a full MoE layer in one call: dispatch, both expert GEMMs, the shared expert and combine. DeepInfer uses them inside one NVLink domain, and always on Ascend.

nvlink-domain.short: A group of NVIDIA GPUs that connect directly through NVLink, so each GPU can read and write the memory of the others. DeepEP reports its size.

symmetric-memory.short: A buffer with the same size on every rank of a group. Each rank can read and write the buffers of its peers directly.

userbuffer.short: DeepInfer's process-wide manager of communication buffers: the DeepEP buffer for MoE, the DeepGEMM symmetric buffers, and the CP and Engram buffers.
